body.p: Heavenly girl. One day a woman began to pray. She says: âGreat Num, give my son to the sun, and Iâll do it somehow. Otherwise, during this month all the people from seven tents have died out". The heavenly girl heard this prayer, her heart suddenly jumped up, she took pity, her tears fell like snow on the ground. The praying woman looked up and saw: white fiery sparks fell to the ground. These fiery sparks turned into white paint when they flew down. This paint spread all over the earth. They fell on a birch, the birchbark suddenly turned white. If it hits a person, it will be cleansed, but it fell on my son - he was cleansed. The woman fell flat on one side and a baby beside her is crying. Those seven tents all hit. After that, only Up Pyak remained. The place where everything happened is on this side of the Siberian Ridges, probably somewhere between Vyngapur and Noyabrsk, on that side. This is a dangerous land. It was there that all the inhabitants of the seven tents of Pyakov died from the epidemic. Only one boy survived. His name seems to be Up, Vaisei Pyak's father.
